title: Four Years of FAccT: A Reflexive, Mixed-Methods Analysis of Research Contributions, Shortcomings, and Future Prospects
reasoning: The paper includes a central analysis (Section 4) evaluating the moral and ethical foundations of the FAccT research community. It utilizes Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and the Moral Foundations Dictionary (MFD) to quantify the presence of moral values, including concepts related to 'sanctity' such as religion and faith, within the conference corpus.
